subject: English First Additional Language

source.subtopic: Understands and uses 'There is / There are' (There is a book on the table)

show.line: There is one lion. There are two lions! Is for one. Are for more.

rounds.prompt: There ... two elephants. Is or are?

rounds.text: There is a book on the table.
accept: there is a book on the table
there is book on the table

rounds.prompt: There ... a monkey in the tree. Is or are?

hints: More than one? Say there are.

beat_the_tutor.setup: My turn! Look at the zebras.
beat_the_tutor.win_line: You caught me! There are five zebras. More than one, so are.
beat_the_tutor.gentle_line: Let's say it together. There are five zebras!

parent_line: Can say there is for one thing and there are for many.
